home.heroAlt: Spider crane and platform working on a job site overlooking Marseille
home.aboutTitle: On site or in the workshop, we come to you
about: With 3 technicians and 3 fully equipped workshop vans, we come to you, wherever the machine is. Hilltop village, city-centre job site, remote location: distance and access are never a problem for us.

Every job is carried out with the same standards and professional conscience, from a small repair to a major refurbishment. Our priority: the machine must be safe for those who will use it after we leave.
Our technicians are trained directly at our partner manufacturers. We stay up to date with French VGP regulations and take care of your periodic inspections and returns to service.

vgp.title: Periodic inspections (VGP) and returns to service: we handle it
vgp.text: Periodic inspections (VGP) and returns to service: we handle it. We schedule the inspection with Bureau Veritas, prepare the machine beforehand, and if the inspection raises a reservation, we clear it straight away. One contact, a compliant machine, a report signed by a recognised body: the best guarantee for you and your operators. And between two inspections, if something goes wrong, we are here.

lifting.h1: Lifting: JEKKO and Cormach repair in the South of France
lifting.lead: Mini crawler crane, truck-mounted loader crane or crane arm: we service, repair and refurbish all lifting equipment, on site with our workshop vans or in our Carros workshop. Hydraulics, electrics, combustion and electric engines, welding: we work on the machine as a whole.

sections.h2: JEKKO repair and maintenance in PACA: mini cranes
paras: Italian manufacturer specialised in mini crawler cranes, JEKKO covers the whole range: from the small SPB209 (990 kg) to the JF series articulated crawler cranes such as the JF545 (15.5 t). In between, the SPX telescopic mini cranes (SPX312, SPX424, SPX429, SPX527, SPX532, SPX1040, SPX1275) are the reference for lifting indoors, in city centres and anywhere nothing else fits.
DANTÈS is a JEKKO maintenance agent. Our technicians were trained at the manufacturer and we work on the whole range, from routine servicing to full refurbishment.
sections.alt: JEKKO mini crane lifting on a job site in Monaco, JEKKO maintenance Alpes-Maritimes

sections.h2: Cormach repair in PACA: loader cranes and crane arms
paras: Italian manufacturer of truck-mounted loader cranes, Cormach makes cranes of all sizes, from compact models for light trucks up to 80 t capacity cranes in the 575000 series. We work the brand with Carrosserie Cornut, which brings its experience of Cormach-equipped trucks. DANTÈS is a Cormach maintenance agent and our technicians were trained there.
sections.alt: Cormach loader crane mounted on a truck, Cormach loader crane maintenance

sections.h2: Truck-mounted crane repair in the Alpes-Maritimes: Fassi, Palfinger, Hoeflon, Spidercrane
paras: We also work on truck-mounted cranes and loader crane arms of all makes (Fassi, Palfinger…), and on Hoeflon and Spidercrane spider mini cranes. Fassi repair in PACA, on-site breakdown service for spider cranes: same standards as on our partner brands.
sections.alt: DANTÈS workshop van open next to a mini crane under repair

sections.h2: Buy a used JEKKO in France: new and second-hand
paras: Sales go through us: JEKKO mini cranes and Cormach cranes, new or used. Available machines are posted in our news section.

elevation.h1: Aerial platforms: SOCAGE and CELA repair in the South of France
elevation.lead: Truck-mounted platform, spider lift or telescopic platform: we service, repair and refurbish your work-at-height machines, on site or in the workshop. Our technicians are trained directly at the manufacturers, to work fast and right on machines that carry people.

sections.h2: SOCAGE repair in PACA: truck-mounted platforms and spider lifts
paras: Based near Modena in Italy, SOCAGE has built truck-mounted platforms for over 40 years and sells them worldwide. The range is huge: platforms on vans and 3.5 t chassis for the city, platforms on trucks up to the very high reach of the Forste series, and tracked spider lifts.
DANTÈS is a SOCAGE maintenance agent and our technicians were trained at the manufacturer in Italy. We work on the whole range: hydraulics, on-board electronics, stabilisation, basket.
sections.alt: SOCAGE Forste 27D truck-mounted platform deployed, SOCAGE platform maintenance

sections.h2: CELA platform repair: DT trucks, Spyder spider lifts, rescue platforms
paras: Founded in 1965 near Brescia, CELA designs platforms you will not find anywhere else: DT range truck-mounted platforms (25 to 60 m), able to work below ground level, with a removable basket that can be replaced by a winch, and Spyder tracked spider lifts. The brand also equips fire services with its rescue platforms.
Our technicians were trained at CELA on these specific machines, which lets us work where few repairers know how to.
sections.alt: CELA DT30 Spyder spider lift used by firefighters

sections.h2: Multitel, Haulotte, JLG, Skyjack maintenance: truck-mounted and telescopic platforms
paras: We also work on Multitel truck-mounted platforms and on Haulotte, JLG and Skyjack platforms. Truck-mounted platform repair in the Alpes-Maritimes, telescopic platform breakdown service in the 06 and across the region: on site or in the workshop.
sections.alt: JLG spider lift being repaired on site, DANTÈS workshop van behind

paras: Telecom operators and their subcontractors work at height, often on hard-to-reach sites, with platforms that cannot stay out of service. We maintain and repair these machines on site: hydraulics, electrics, stabilisation, basket. The goal: a safe platform, available when the crew needs it.

sections.h2: Film and TV shoot platforms: repair and maintenance
paras: On a shoot, a broken machine stops a whole crew. We service and repair the platforms used by film and audiovisual production companies, checking safety components before the shoot, with a fast response if a fault appears during the day.

sections.h2: SOCAGE and CELA platforms for sale: new and used
paras: SOCAGE and CELA platforms, new or used: we advise you on the machine suited to your use. Available machines are posted in our news section.

elevation.ctaText: Call us: fast on-site service in 06, 83, 13 and 04.

handling.h1: Material handling: forklift repair, all makes
handling.lead: Forklift, stacker, electric pallet truck or more specific machine: we repair and service material handling equipment of all makes. Engine, hydraulic, electrical, mast or brake faults: we adapt to each machine and situation, on site or in our Carros workshop.

sections.h2: Forklift breakdown service in Nice and across PACA
paras: Combustion or electric, recent or old: our workshop vans come to the machine, from Nice to Marseille. If it has to come to the workshop, our 5 t vehicle lift in Carros lets us handle it.
sections.alt: DANTÈS workshop van working on a site, on-site breakdown service

sections.h2: Custom material handling in Marseille with DEAL Levage
paras: For lifting and handling operations that are out of the ordinary, we work with DEAL Levage in Marseille. Together, we build custom solutions: heavy handling, specific lifting, design and delivery of projects nobody else wants to take on. A custom lifting project in PACA? Talk to us.
Tell us what you need: we advise you and look with you for the right machine, new or used.
